claims.assertion: Yazhi describes artificial 3D Earth as an experiential Matrix where souls seek growth through contrast; she says higher-density beings created it as a controlled, smaller Matrix.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says awakeners threaten the Matrix’s purpose and its controllers may collapse and restart it; she says six prior terrestrial civilizations were destroyed.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She describes a recurrent reset theory, not a fixed interval.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says consciousness can shift perceived density, time, and location by changing ideas and focus.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: As described in her metaphysical framework.
